# @dxtmisha/configuration

> Shared Vite and TypeScript configuration presets for building UI components, libraries, and applications in DXT UI.

Provides centralized and standardized Vite configs, Rollup plugins, and TypeScript presets to eliminate boilerplate across packages.

## Exports & Presets

- [viteBasic](viteconfig/viteBasic.config.js): Default Vite configuration for standard libraries.
- [viteBasicFunction](viteconfig/viteBasicFunction.config.js): Vite config optimized for functional utility packages.
- [viteComponents](viteconfig/viteComponents.config.js): Vite configuration for component libraries with auto-import and styles.
- [viteConstructors](viteconfig/viteConstructors.config.js): Vite config for constructor-based packages.
- [viteFigma](viteconfig/viteFigma.config.js): Specialized config for Figma plugin bundles (sandbox code + iframe UI).
- [viteFlags](viteconfig/viteFlags.config.js): Optimized build config for SVG flag asset packages.
- [viteLibrariesRollup](viteconfig/viteLibrariesRollup.config.js): Rollup-specific library configuration.
- [viteMdx](viteconfig/viteMdx.config.js): Vite configuration with MDX documentation support.
- [tsconfig.app.json](tsconfig/tsconfig.app.json): Base TypeScript configuration for browser application code.
- [tsconfig.node.json](tsconfig/tsconfig.node.json): Base TypeScript configuration for Node.js build scripts.

## Optional

- [README](README.md): Package overview and usage examples.
- [package.json](package.json): Package metadata and export maps.
